title: coder and web chat: web fetch and web search tools
body:
coder-new, microcoder, the CLI and the web chat have no fetch or search tool. Only `curl` via `Run` works.

Do:
- `web_fetch(url, prompt)` returns readable text/markdown with a size cap, refuses private IPs, and caches for 15 min.
- `web_search(query)` goes through one provider behind the gateway.
- Both run as coder tools and as web-chat tools. The chat cites fetched URLs.

Acceptance:
- [ ] Fetching a docs page and answering a question about it works in coder and on staging chat.
- [ ] Private IPs are refused (test).

Phase: This weekend. Parity doc: https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/docs/kitchen-sink/orchestrator-parity.md (row J). Part of the orchestrator-parity umbrella.
